item: Fixed O2 monitor for the lab room (breathing height and near the argon cylinder)
part: Macurco OX-6 (0-25 % O2; 4-20 mA; 2 relays; LED)
price_basis: search extract (Kele page hides price; list $1275)
notes: BOM S7 (McMaster 18995T81, $459) is a Portable Detector with a nonreplaceable 2-year battery, not a fixed monitor. Relay 1 = 20.0 % warning, relay 2 = 19.5 % evacuate and close argon; wire the relays into the safety controller, not only a horn. Alternative: Sensidyne SensAlarm O2 or PureAire 0-25 % (no price read).

item: Fixed O2 monitor inside the Kardex Shuttle shaft (low) and one at the tray bay
part: Macurco OX-6 (same part)
notes: Independent of the room monitor. One near the shaft floor (argon pools), one at the tray bay, both on the VLM's interlock and the tray's safety input. Cable runs and relay-to-Kardex interface need Kardex approval.

item: Personal O2 monitor for filter changes and any entry
part: McMaster 18995T81 portable O2 detector (nonreplaceable battery)
notes: Good as a personal monitor for the person at the machine; two-year disposable. Not a substitute for fixed monitors.

item: Argon supply shutoff driven by the O2 relay
part: McMaster 8077K237 24 V normally-closed solenoid (already in BOM G7)
notes: Fail-closed on loss of power or monitor fault. Add a second solenoid at the cylinder or wall outlet, outside the Shuttle, so the whole line is dead upstream.

item: Critical-flow (sonic) orifice in the argon line
part: Critical-flow orifice, 0.5-1 mm class (Lee Co. or O'Keefe Controls)
notes: Caps the worst-case inflow at 12-47 L/min at 7 bar (safety_calcs.py) so a failed regulator cannot dump a cylinder. Size it from the purge demand.

item: Low-pressure relief on the chamber (BOM part)
part: McMaster 4277T52 nylon relief 0.5 psi (34.5 mbar)
notes: Cv 'Not Rated', set accuracy +/- 20 %, built for air. Fine as the first stage; it is not a sized relief. Add SP7 or SP8.

item: Rated overpressure relief (spring) on a KF port
part: Accuglass PRV-K40 KF-40 relief valve (set 2 psi; adjustable 0.5-2.0 psi)
notes: Check its flow rating (Cv) against the orifice flow; vent it to a duct that leaves the Shuttle and the room.

item: Last-resort burst disc on a KF-40 port
part: IdealVac KF-40 burst disk (9-11 psi)
notes: Bursts at 0.6-0.76 bar-g: the lid, door latches and window retention are sized for a full atmosphere (seals.md, fea.md), so the machine can take it. One-shot.

item: Argon cylinder restraint and smallest cylinder
part: Airgas size 80 argon (~85 ft3 = 2.4 m3) with wall chain or stand
notes: BYU's chemical hygiene plan: smallest cylinder that does the job; secured by strap or chain; never bleed empty. Size 80 alone takes a 30 m3 room to 19.3 % if all of it is released. Keep it outside the Shuttle.

item: Pump exhaust duct to outdoors with a flow switch
part: 1-1/2 in. exhaust line + KF-25 hose + a flow or pressure switch on the duct
notes: Pump exhaust carries 38 L of argon per start-up (calcs) and powder dust. Vent outside the room and out of the Shuttle; interlock purge to the flow switch.

item: Class 4 danger sign for the room door
part: Safetysign.com Danger Class 4 Laser sign A0043-FK
notes: Text to be agreed with BYU's LSO. Add the invisible-radiation label (SP12) on the guard and the laser housing.

item: Invisible laser radiation label on guard and housing
part: Safetysign.com 50101 Caution Class 4 Invisible Laser Radiation label
notes: Also label 'laser radiation when open' on every interlocked panel.

item: Laser-on warning beacon
part: McMaster 1577T43 LED stack light + 7545K316 red emission light
notes: Already in BOM S4. Put one outside the room door and one on the guard; drive from the safety controller's emission output, not from software.

item: Guard-locking interlock (BOM part)
part: Omron D4JL-4NFA-C5-NPT
notes: Check it is a power-to-unlock (solenoid-held) or power-to-lock type to match the logic; a spring-lock switch drops the lock on power loss, which is wrong for a vacuum or hot-plate lock unless a separate hold is added.

item: Second guard-locking interlock (cheaper alternative / second guard)
part: Banner SI-LS42DMG solenoid-lock safety interlock
notes: Not the same family as the Omron; confirm coded-actuator type, ISO 14119 level and spring/solenoid lock before choosing.

item: Safety controller (replace the G9SE-201)
part: Banner SC26-2DE (26 safety inputs, 4 safety outputs)
price_basis: search extract (DigiKey SC26-2E: GBP 1019.29 ex VAT)
notes: The G9SE-201 ($275.29) has too few channels for guard (2), 2 E-stops, key, shutter feedback, O2 permissive, plate-below-50-C, VLM and MiR signals. A programmable controller also gives a reset logic and diagnostics. Pilz PNOZmulti is the other family; no price read.

item: Laser safety shutter + beam dump
part: Industrial fiber-laser shutter (quote) + Thorlabs LB2L/M 500 W dump
notes: Shutter must be normally closed and monitored (feedback contact into the controller). Add a cooled dump or absorber for the beam path of every reachable direction (floor plate under the f-theta).

item: Guard viewing window
part: Thorlabs LW1P1/M light green panel (385.8 x 304.8 mm)
notes: Need OD >= 5.4 at 1070 nm for 500 W (calcs) with a rated damage power density for the stated time. Panel mounting: no direct line to the beam.

item: Service eyewear
part: Thorlabs LG1 laser safety glasses
notes: Confirm OD at 1070 nm and a CW damage rating (EN 207 D rating) from the datasheet. Align at reduced power so the eyewear is never the only control.

item: Class D extinguisher (BOM part)
part: McMaster 6435T23 sodium chloride 30 lb
notes: BYU stocks yellow Class D units in its science buildings (risk.byu.edu/fire-extinguishers): ask the Fire Marshal for the lab's Class D plan before buying. Mount outside the Shuttle and the room door, not inside it.

item: Dry sand pail with lid (cover for small powder and condensate fires)
part: Steel covered pail + dry sand (or the extinguishing agent chosen in the DHA)
notes: EOS advises a sand tub at hand for filter changes. Keep out of water and damp air.

item: Aspirating smoke detection in the Shuttle
part: Xtralis/Kidde VESDA VLF-250 + VSP-722 aspirator
notes: VLM towers hide fires and defeat sprinklers (pain-points P51). Whether to fit one is a Kardex plus Fire Marshal decision; this is the part to ask about.

item: Combustible-metal-dust vacuum (BOM part)
part: McMaster 5572N116 air-powered Class II Div 1 Groups E-G
notes: Needs 35 scfm of dry compressed air; its exhaust goes through HEPA but still into the room. Never use it on fresh condensate until passivated.

item: Alternative combustible-metal vacuum (water immersion)
part: Dynabrade 61496 pneumatic immersion vac (Div 1)
notes: 3 lb capacity; water + Al fines gives hydrogen, so it needs venting and a DHA entry. Alternatives: PrestiVac EV2-15 EX $8283.

item: Grounding and bonding kit (static ground wire with clamps; bond the chamber, reservoirs, hoses, vacuum, pails)
part: McMaster static grounding wires with clamps
price_basis: estimate (category page read; no part priced)
notes: Add a bonding point on the chamber, one on the filter housing, one on the reservoir dock and one on the exchange pail; check resistance after each change.

item: Ground-continuity tester
part: Handheld 1-ohm continuity or megohmmeter
notes: Check bonds to ground each shift; log it.

item: Filter-change bag-out kit
part: Grounded stainless transfer container with lid + dry sand + bag-out bags + non-sparking scoop + nitrile over butyl gloves
notes: Spent condensate and the filter go into the container under sand, labelled; to BYU's waste stream (Unwanted Lab Material) per the DHA.

item: Full-facepiece respirator
part: 3M 6800 (medium) + 3M 2091 P100 filters
notes: Only under BYU's respiratory protection program (fit test, medical check). A P100 gives no oxygen. Filters $14-15 per pair.

item: Flame-resistant coveralls and gloves
part: Nomex-class coveralls; heat-resistant gloves for 200 C parts
notes: NIST used FR clothing for aluminium and filter work, and thermal gloves for an 80 C platform; this plate is 200 C.

item: E-stops (BOM part)
part: IDEC XA1E-BV3U02-R
notes: Add one on the guard front, one at the room door, one on the VLM/robot cell. All into the safety controller (SP16). Reset by hand outside the hazard zone.

item: Heater limit controller (BOM part)
part: DwyerOmega CN708 latching limit
notes: Latching; manual reset. Wire its relay into the safety controller as the 'plate below 50 C' input.

item: Lockable disconnect for the 240 V feed
part: Lockable 2-pole disconnect or breaker lock-off at the dock and at the machine
notes: LOTO point; BYU's LOTO program page is login-gated.

item: Presence scanner or light curtain on the aisle side of the guard (check Kardex and MiR first)
part: Safety laser scanner or ESPE (ISO 13855 distance)
notes: Only if the MiR's own scanners and the Kardex opening guarding do not cover the machine front. Compute S = K T + C.
